name: com.faolline.graphgameflow.addressables
description: Optional bridge: an ISceneLoader/ISceneUnloader (from com.faolline.graphgameflow) backed by com.unity.addressables, so LoadSceneAction/UnloadSceneAction can load scenes by Addressable key instead of a Build Settings entry. Add only if you use Addressables; graphgameflow core stays dependency-free.
